_comment: Per-location forward-suggestion pools, weighted by MEASURED POS sales (14-day pull 2026-08-19). Only POS-verified, reply-safe names. Fish tacos are the runaway #1 seller at every location (~15-20x the #2 item) but their weight is deliberately capped — variation on the profile page beats accuracy of proportion. suggestRate = fraction of eligible 4-5★ replies that carry ANY forward dish suggestion; cooldown = how many suggestions must pass at a location before the same dish may repeat. Refresh weights occasionally from the POS item ranks.
